notes: AudioRecorder: streamed Loop mode is now seamless -- a small (~21ms) precomputed equal-power crossfade of the loop window's true tail fading into its true head is spliced in at each loop point instead of a raw reseek cut, removing the ~20ms silence gap introduced in 1.10.69. Uses two tiny (4KB each) PSRAM buffers, not the old large RAM window buffer, so it doesn't reintroduce the PSRAM-budget-sharing problem that caused the original truncation bug. Falls back to a plain reseek (small gap, no click-masking) if the window is too short for a real crossfade or the tiny buffers fail to allocate. Non-Loop trim/one-shot streaming and Reverse playback are unaffected.
